title: Crypto misuse: GCM inbuf reset zeros inbuf_len not inbuf_cap
description: wolfssl_aes_gcm_sess_reset (wolfssl_aes_gcm.c:183) and kcapi_aead_sess_reset (kcapi_aead.c:106) call memzero_explicit(ctx->inbuf, ctx->inbuf_len) but not memzero_explicit(ctx->inbuf, ctx->inbuf_cap). After RESET, stale ciphertext bytes remain in inbuf[inbuf_len..inbuf_cap). FIPS 140-3 zeroization requires all sensitive data to be wiped before the memory is repurposed. The region [inbuf_len..inbuf_cap) contains ciphertext from the previous decrypt session and is not cleared. Fix: zero inbuf_cap bytes, not inbuf_len bytes, in both sess_reset implementations.
